description: Dynamic attributes of an expanded body's remaining body include those partial processing took
notes: The spec's partial processing leaves every attribute the schema requested out of the remaining body. With dynamic blocks expanded, hashicorp/hcl answers dynamic attributes processing of the remaining body with every attribute of the original body (expandBody.JustAttributes in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go doesn't leave out the attributes that PartialContent took), so a is in the remaining body too.
